items.title: Forget AT&T and Verizon: Crown Castle Has More to Lose From Starlink’s 40x Upgrade
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said SpaceX’s next direct-to-cell satellites will have 40x the bandwidth of today’s, and that AT&T and Verizon may lose some revenue. Crown Castle has more at stake than either carrier, since AT&T and Verizon pay 51% of its tower rent.

items.title: Crown Castle (CCI) Up 3.9% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.summary: Crown Castle (CCI) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: Crown Castle vs. American Tower: Higher Yield or Better Dividend Growth
items.summary: One tower REIT hands retirees a bigger check today, while the other has a dividend with room to grow. Before choosing, weigh the payout cut, the debt load, and a trough year that both companies are betting on.

items.title: Crown Castle Sees Growth Rebound in 2027 as New Spectrum Fuels Tower Demand

items.title: 3 Cell Tower REITs Positioned to Profit as Wireless Data Demand Quadruples
items.summary: One tower REIT slashed its dividend last year, another has raised its payout every year since 2019, and a third yields the most with the least cushion. Which one deserves your income dollars before the next spectrum auction?

items.title: Billboards and Cell Towers Collect Rent From Brands and Carriers, and $120,000 Across These 3 Stocks Pays $5,077 a Year
items.summary: A highway billboard and a ridge-top cell tower run on the same simple model: own the structure, collect the rent. Three REIT landlords turn that rent into dividends, but one has already slashed its payout, and the ad-driven names carry their own boom-and-bust risk.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Crown Castle Stock?
items.summary: Crown Castle has underperformed the broader market over the past year, but analysts are moderately optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Crown Castle Soars 31% in a Month on SpaceX’s Tower Push: “We’re Talking to All Parties”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle (CCI) stock surged 31% from October 2 to November 2, closing at $87. 03 as SpaceX (SPCX) pursued wireless spectrum and potential tower leases.
